name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Tomasz Buczek
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided to lift the legal protection from prosecution that Tomasz Buczek, a Polish member, holds as an elected representative. A Polish court asked for this because it wants to pursue a criminal case against him. The case concerns an incident at an election rally in Tarnobrzeg on 21 September 2024, where he is accused of grabbing a woman's small megaphone so roughly that it broke. Parliament found no sign that the case was brought to harm his political work.

- A Polish court can now pursue its criminal case against Tomasz Buczek.
- It affects Buczek, the woman who filed the complaint, and the Polish court.
- Parliament's President sends the decision to the Polish court and to Buczek.
